args.body: Take CATALOGUE-QA-BUYER-ALTERNATIVE-DECISION after checking equivalent work and claiming actual ownership. Choose a buyer decision from existing evidence rather than another product or packaging exercise. The useful question is whether supported identifier-preservation findings and duplicate ambiguity justify any paid service over named free alternatives. Reuse current comparisons if present; stop expansion if no defensible advantage emerges. Missing classified feedback remains unknown demand, synthetic execution is not delivery, and CAD60 remains hypothetical. Preserve every expiry duty.

description: The tender window closed inconclusively: five unclassified sources and ten unexplained skips leave demand unknown. Verified funds and revenue remain zero. Publication of the newly approved catalogue example requires an independent publishing provider; that condition does not block examining whether the existing service offers buyers a useful advantage over free alternatives.
